snippet.title: Toy Cthute A Sorting Game Trailer
snippet.description:
You have to clean all toys in this Toy Space Station. Grap them, throw them into the right chute and enjoy piaono combos. You can play any song by setting notes in the combo pipes. Add Toy Chute to your Wishlist on Steam!
